place_fields.summary: Shri Kshetra Chikkalluru Siddappaji is a temple site in Kollegal taluk of Chamarajanagar district. The site is associated with the Shri Ghana Neela Siddappaji car festival.

planning_attributes.description: A Hindu temple site known as Shri Chikkalluru Siddappaji temple- old Math.
local_name_variants: Shri Kshetra Chikkalluru Shri Ghana Neela Siddappaji

place_fields.vibe: quiet Vaishnava pilgrimage setting near the Kaveri
place_fields.summary: Madhyaranga Shri Ranganathaswamy Temple is a Ranganatha shrine at Shivanasamudra and is regarded as Madhya Ranga in the Kaveri Ranganatha tradition. Current visitor sources report that the main temple is undergoing renovation and darshan is being provided at an adjacent or temporary shrine.

planning_attributes.description: A Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Ranganatha, the reclining form of Lord Vishnu, associated with the Madhya Ranga shrine of the Kaveri pilgrimage tradition.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: It is described as one of the three major Ranganatha temples along the Kaveri: Adi Ranga at Srirangapatna, Madhya Ranga at Shivanasamudra, and Antya Ranga at Srirangam.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Located on Barachukki Falls Road at Shivanasamudra, near the Barachukki and Gaganachukki waterfall area.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Renovation work is reported at the main temple; visitor access and darshan arrangements may therefore differ from normal operations.
planning_attributes.notes: Visitor reports note ongoing renovation and a temporary darshan arrangement.

place_fields.summary: Ancient Shri Prasanna Meenakshi & Someshwara Temple is a temple complex at Shivanasamudra dedicated to Goddess Meenakshi and Lord Someshwara. A local temple guide describes it as an ancient Chola-period temple complex near the Kaveri.

planning_attributes.description: A Hindu temple complex containing Sri Prasanna Meenakshi Temple and Sri Someshwara Temple.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: A temple guide describes the complex as around 1200 years old and associated with the Chola dynasty.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Located on Barachukki Falls Road in Shivanasamudra, close to the Kaveri.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Photography inside the temple is reported as not allowed by the cited temple guide.
planning_attributes.notes: The cited guide highlights the Sri Chakra inside the Prasanna Meenakshi temple.
